classifications.grouping: Technologists, Technicians & Other Technical Service Providers
classifications.definition: A specialist or technologist providing surgical-adjacent technical services. Works under the supervision of a surgeon to facilitate invasive procedures; handles sterile technique, equipment, and operative-environment safety.

is_supplemented.note: Sourced from CMS/NPPES; not published in current NUCC v261. Canonical NUCC equivalent is 246ZS0410X (Surgical Technologist). Discovered in production 2026-08-01 via nationwide pipeline run be16a3. Sample NPI: 1417801002 (WILLIAM WALLER, CCP, GA).
